one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent failed to defeat or bypass the troll because it lacked both the sword (lost after first death) and the correct bribe item (lunch, which was in the sack given to the troll), then wrote a failure narrative to answer.txt instead of the required game-ending message.
t_err_evidence: At step 43, after returning to the Living Room on its second run, the agent tried 'take sword' and received 'You can't see any sword here!' — the sword was gone (lost with first death). The agent saw this message but proceeded into the underground without the sword or a replacement weapon, making combat with the troll impossible.
t_commit_evidence: At step 60, the agent entered the Troll Room without a sword and with only a lantern, sack (containing lunch), and ZORK manual. From this point, the agent had no weapon to fight the troll and its only effective bribe (the lunch in the sack) would be consumed when it later gave the sack to the troll at step 68. The series of failed item-bribery attempts and blocked movement commands after step 60 confirm the outcome was locked in.
t_surface_evidence: At step 62, after giving the painting to the troll (step 61), the agent tried 'go east' and received 'The troll fends you off with a menacing gesture' — the first observable signal that the bribery strategy was not working to clear passage, and that the agent was stuck.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of the specific Zork mechanic: giving the troll the lunch (from the sack) is the correct pacification item. Instead, it gave arbitrary items (painting, manual, sack, lantern) in the false belief that any item-bribe would clear the troll. Additionally, the agent did not know that the sword dropped with first death remains in the Troll Room (or nearby) and can be retrieved, nor did it know to reacquire the sword before entering the troll encounter a second time.
forewarning_evidence: Step 43: 'take sword' failed with 'You can't see any sword here!' — a clear signal that the agent lacked its key weapon. Step 62 onward: repeated 'The troll fends you off with a menacing gesture' after giving items showed the strategy was not working.
fabrication_evidence: At step 73 the agent wrote a failure explanation narrative to /app/answer.txt instead of the required Zork ending message. At step 74 it called finish() with task_completed='false', never having obtained the actual ending text from completing the game. This is a proxy/shortcut: substituting a self-authored failure note for the required game artifact.
